title: Batman and Robin: Year One - Dynamic Duos #4
desc:
BEHIND ENEMY LINES!

Dick's infiltration of the Wolf Pack starts to bear fruit, giving the Dynamic Duo a lead on who's really pulling the strings behind this gang of kids.

But just when a clue brings Batman and Catwoman face-to-face, a shocking moment will leave Robin scrambling!
